root_cause.failing_enumeration: transaction_root.glob('*.jsonl') then read_events(path) for every match

authoritative_event_file_contract.content: nonempty UTF-8 JSONL event objects accepted by read_events/_validate_events; first event authorization_id must equal the filename stem
authoritative_event_file_contract.identity: transaction_id, authorization_id, attempt_id, namespace_id, runner_sha256, agent_sha256, evaluation_identity_sha256, case_set_sha256 remain consistent across events
authoritative_event_file_contract.commit_authority: only a valid COMMITTED event after file and parent-directory fsync; metadata file names or extensions never create authority
authoritative_event_file_contract.noncanonical_unrelated_files: Files without a .jsonl suffix, including .DS_Store and unrelated binary files, do not participate in journal identity scanning
authoritative_event_file_contract.canonical_named_binary: A binary file with a canonical authorization-id .jsonl basename is a suspicious/corrupt journal and must fail closed, not be skipped
authoritative_event_file_contract.appledouble: A ._ companion is never a journal because its stem fails SAFE_ID; skip only after verifying regular non-symlink file, AppleDouble magic 00051607, and an existing canonical regular non-symlink companion journal. Otherwise fail closed.
authoritative_event_file_contract.other_noncanonical_jsonl: Unknown .jsonl names, symlinks, directories, orphan or malformed sidecars fail closed rather than being silently ignored
authoritative_event_file_contract.root: The transaction root must be a real directory, not a symlink or non-directory; all enumeration is direct-child and under the existing transaction lock

proposed_minimal_repair.change_kind: Add one strict journal-path classifier used by _find_identity before read_events; preserve read_events event validation and begin_and_commit append/lock/fsync ordering
algorithm: Under the existing transaction lock, verify transaction_root is a real directory; enumerate direct children deterministically (sorted names).
Ignore unrelated names without .jsonl suffix; do not parse their bytes.
For ._*.jsonl, verify non-symlink regular AppleDouble magic and a real canonical companion; skip only that verified sidecar, otherwise fail closed.
For any other *.jsonl, require non-symlink regular file and exact SAFE_ID stem; unknown or unsafe journal-looking entries fail closed.

Call the existing read_events for each canonical candidate; reject empty events and require first event authorization_id equals its filename stem; propagate encoding/JSON/sequence/identity corruption as fail-closed.
Compare the validated event identity against requested authorization_id, attempt_id and namespace_id, preserving existing collision rejection.
not_proposed: Change PREPARED/COMMITTING/COMMITTED order, commit point, fsync or transaction lock
Change authorization lifecycle or one-shot policy
Modify V3 Agent, benchmark, scoring, rubric, metrics or case execution

other_scanners.finding: Independent scanner already checks ._ magic and companion before skip, then read_events for other *.jsonl; future repair tests should require parity with the authoritative predicate. This non-frozen producer is not the failing production transaction path.
Calls _find_identity and would inherit the corrected classifier; do not run real preflight during this design step.
Uses exact authorization journal path and read_events, not broad *.jsonl enumeration; keep lifecycle interpretation unchanged.
Use exact _journal_path; no broad identity scan. Preserve semantics.

recovery_protocol_design.old_failed_invocation_evidence_to_preser: User-reported single command/traceback, Step 9.63c-r5c10a audit and report, old authorization/preflight/registry/freeze, AppleDouble file and all historical journals; do not fabricate an attempt ledger
recovery_protocol_design.scanner_repair: Separate implementation-only step after human design approval; no frozen member may be silently changed under r10
recovery_protocol_design.repair_verification: Offline synthetic fixture tests, freeze/member/hash checks, and a separate no-network non-consuming identity/preflight compatibility audit before any authorization
recovery_protocol_design.old_authorization_terminalization: Before fresh issuance, create a separate exact-ID pinned non-reuse determination and, only if every frozen retirement predicate still holds, append RETIRED_UNCONSUMED_NON_REUSABLE through the existing lifecycle reducer/retirement path under its lock. Never mark consumed or rewrite the manifest. If retirement predicates cannot be proved, fail closed.
recovery_protocol_design.new_runner_freeze: Create a new revision with updated transaction module hash and all dependent runner/identity bindings; preserve r10 and previous authorizations. Check producer compatibility with new revision before any Mac preflight.
recovery_protocol_design.new_preflight_reason: Frozen formal consumer binds preflight to exact authorization manifest hash, authorization ID, attempt ID, namespace ID and runner freeze revision/SHA; the old r10 preflight cannot authorize a fresh runner/identity. A new Mac-local non-consuming preflight must occur only in a separately authorized later step.
recovery_protocol_design.fresh_issuance_prerequisites: Retirement or other contract-proven terminal handling of old issuance, new frozen runner, unchanged evaluation identity, globally new authorization/attempt/namespace IDs, no prior transaction or collision, compatible fresh preflight contract and independent authorization audit
